# Third-party provenance

Reviewed on 2026-10-12. No third-party author endorses this app.

## HorizonCalendar — actual Swift Package dependency

- Repository: https://github.com/airbnb/HorizonCalendar
- Pinned revision: `257927434aecbc4a70163570b5ef40976f0428a2`
- License: Apache-2.0; full text in `HorizonCalendar-LICENSE.txt`.
- Usage: date browsing and selection through `CalendarViewRepresentable`. The course engine and subject characters are original project code.
- Upstream code is unmodified.

## AIRI — concept reference only

https://github.com/moeru-ai/airi was reviewed for the broad idea of connecting dialogue with character state. No source, character art, models, audio, branding, or other assets were copied.

The characters 规、折、逗、凸、弹、试 and their instrument animations are original to this prototype. The package still requires resolution and compilation on an Apple toolchain. A pinned revision is not proof of runtime compatibility.
